ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Soil its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Plants its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

2. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

4. C — 100 °C

5. C — Glucose and oxygen

6. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

10. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
